rules.remove_body: The endpoint receives every subscribed event with the standard body again. Old versions stay available for restore.
rules.missing_events: The rule needs events this endpoint does not subscribe to: {types}.
rules.will_subscribe: Saving also subscribes the endpoint to: {types}.
rules.filter_subtitle: Only events that match are delivered.
rules.map_subtitle: Shape the body your system receives.
rules.matches_everything: No conditions: every subscribed event matches.
rules.needs: This rule makes the sync fetch {what} for every message of these accounts, which costs extra I/O.

code_reason.advanced: This expression goes beyond what the guided builder can show, so it opens as code.
code_reason.edited: The filter was edited as code after it was built, so it opens as code.
code_reason.comment: The map contains comments, which the visual editor would lose, so it opens as code.
code_reason.expression: The map is a single expression (merge, pick, a condition…), so it is edited as code.

rules.leave_body: Your changes to the filter and map will be lost.

builder.label: Label
builder.inbox_any_hint: IMAP INBOX, Gmail's Inbox label and Microsoft's Inbox
builder.match_any_hint: at least one condition must be true
builder.match_not_hint: the conditions together must NOT be true
builder.empty_root: No conditions yet: every subscribed event is sent. Add a condition or pick a preset.

map.none: No map: the endpoint receives the standard event body. Start from:
map.secret_hint: A settings.env secret: its value is filled in at delivery and masked in tests.
map.secret_invalid: Letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _ (max 64).
map.expression_hint: Any CEL, e.g. a condition with ? and :
map.duplicate_key: This key is used twice: only the last one is sent.

code.map_placeholder: For example: an object with "id": data.messageId

preset.title: Start from a preset
preset.secret_explain: The shared key is never written in the rule. The rule reads it from a settings.env secret by name, and the value is masked everywhere.
preset.secret_value_hint: Stores or replaces the secret now. Leave empty if it is already set.

keyedInbound.title: Inbound mail with shared key
keyedInbound.body: New mail in the Inbox (any provider) sends the shared key and id, date, account, event, headers, emailid and subject.

keyedStatus.title: Send status with shared key
keyedStatus.body: Sent, failed and delivery-error events send the shared key and the whole event.

inboxMail.title: New mail in the Inbox
inboxMail.body: Only new messages that land in the Inbox, including Gmail's Inbox label.

pecReceipts.title: PEC receipts
pecReceipts.body: Acceptance, delivery and error receipts of certified mail.

withAttachments.title: Messages with attachments
withAttachments.body: New messages that carry at least one attachment.

bounces.title: Bounces
bounces.body: Bounce events and received messages detected as bounces.

notAutoReply.title: No auto-replies
notAutoReply.body: New mail except out-of-office and other automatic replies.

slimPayload.title: Slim payload
slimPayload.body: Keeps the filter and sends a small body: id, type, time, account, message id, subject, sender.

test.title: Test
test.subtitle: Live result of your draft, before you save.
test.no_events: No events in the last 24 hours. Use a sample or paste an event.
test.paste_placeholder: Paste an event (the JSON of a delivery or of the events page).
test.paste_not_object: The JSON must be an object.
test.pick_source: Pick an event to test with.
test.delivered_as_is: Delivered with the standard event body.

insights.title: In production
insights.no_decisions: No decisions yet: they appear as events arrive.

versions.title: Rule versions
versions.restore_body: It becomes a new current version; nothing is deleted.

summary.after_create: Save the endpoint first, then decide which events to send and what body they carry.

lists.title: Named lists
lists.subtitle: Domains, addresses and keywords your rules check with inList().
lists.delete_body: Rules that use this list stop matching it.
lists.name: Name
lists.name_hint: Used in rules, e.g. inList("vip", fromDomain()).
lists.too_long: An entry is at most {n} bytes.
lists.empty: No lists yet. Create one to match VIP domains or blocked senders.

event.account_initialized: An account finished its first sync
event.account_auth_failed: Login to the mail server failed
event.account_connect_failed: The mail server could not be reached
event.message_updated: Flags or labels of a message changed
event.message_missing: A message disappeared from the server
event.message_sent: An outgoing message was accepted by the server
event.message_delivery_attempt_failed: A send attempt failed and will be retried
event.message_captured: The sandbox captured an outgoing message
event.message_complained: A recipient reported a message as spam

helper.isInbox: True when the message is in the Inbox on any provider (IMAP INBOX, Gmail Inbox label, Microsoft Inbox).
helper.inFolder: True when the folder path or its role (\Sent, \Junk…) matches, ignoring case.
helper.hasLabel: True when the message carries the label (Gmail labels and flags).
helper.labels: Label and flag names on the message.
helper.text: Plain text of the body (HTML stripped), capped at 64 KiB. Makes the sync fetch the body.
helper.textContains: True when the body text contains the words, ignoring case.
helper.textMatches: True when the body text matches the RE2 regular expression.
helper.subject: The subject, or empty.
helper.subjectContains: True when the subject contains the words, ignoring case.
helper.subjectMatches: True when the subject matches the RE2 regular expression.
helper.hasAttachments: True when the message has attachments.
helper.attachments: Attachments: filename, contentType, size, contentId, inline.
helper.hasAttachment: True when an attachment name matches a glob (*.pdf) or /regex/.
helper.attachmentTypes: Distinct content types of the attachments, lower case.
helper.inDomains: True when the sender or a recipient is in one of the domains.
helper.isReply: True for replies (In-Reply-To, References or a Re: subject).
helper.isForward: True for forwards (Fwd: subject or provider flag).
helper.isAutoReply: True for automatic replies (Auto-Submitted, out of office, bulk).
helper.isBounce: True for bounces and delivery reports.
helper.header: The first value of a header (name in lower case).
helper.hasHeader: True when the header is present.
helper.spf: SPF result word (pass, fail…), empty when absent.
helper.dkim: DKIM result: pass when any signature passed.
helper.dmarc: DMARC result word, empty when absent.
helper.spamScore: Rspamd spam score, 0 when not scanned.
helper.pecType: PEC message or receipt type, empty for normal mail.
helper.localTime: Event time in an IANA time zone.
helper.weekdayOf: Day of the week, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.
helper.businessHours: True when the event time is inside the window and days in that time zone.
helper.inList: True when the value is in the named list.
helper.merge: Shallow merge of two maps; keys of the second win.
helper.pick: Only the listed keys of a map.
helper.omit: A map without the listed keys.
